title: Add 'Find in Folder...' to FileSystem context menu
body: Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/11291 This PR simply opens the existing 'Find in Files' popup with the folder field pre-populated.

files.patch:
@@ -137,6 +137,7 @@ class FileSystemDock : public EditorDock {
 		FILE_MENU_NEW_SCRIPT,
 		FILE_MENU_NEW_SCENE,
 		FILE_MENU_RUN_SCRIPT,
+		FILE_MENU_FIND_IN_FOLDER,
 		FILE_MENU_MAX,
 		// Extra shortcuts that don't exist in the menu.
 		EXTRA_FOCUS_PATH,
